Assets.NotesMarkdown: History shows Stop loss and Take profit by default, and the level that closed a trade is tinted, red for SL and green for TP, like MT5. An optional Reason column shows TP, SL, SO (stop-out), Manual, Partial or Close by. The order ticket's Sell and Buy buttons are tinted red and green, and the chart's 1-click buttons a little stronger. Tab counts show only on Trade and Pending. In By symbol view the group row says 2 positions, and Stop loss and Take profit show Custom when the positions differ (hover to see each). The order confirmation mentions max slippage only when you set a limit. A disabled Trade Assistant stays in place, dimmed. The right column fits Order ticket, Trade Assistant, Sessions and Account without cutting off the Account section. Charts keep candles above the time axis and scale to include the longest wicks. Margin level turns amber below your margin call level and red below stop-out; both levels are now in the account menu.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: Clicks answer at once: orders, closes and changes show Sending… immediately and finish in a fraction of a second, even on a slow computer, and live prices no longer slow the window down. Sign in inside the main window: it opens at its last size, and with Remember me it signs straight in. Choose Live or Demo when you sign in; a demo account under Live is refused with a clear message. Every password field has a show/hide eye and a Caps Lock warning. Session expired, switch account and confirmations appear inside the window. Account details (F7) shows your group, leverage, margin call and stop-out levels and server. No sounds before sign-in, and the connection sound is a setting. Optional diagnostics log in Settings.

Assets.NotesMarkdown: One-click trading is instant: the position appears on the chart and in the Trade tab the moment you click, and updates to the confirmed price and ticket when the server answers; a rejected order is removed with a clear message. An order from the ticket shows Sending… only on the button you pressed; every other button stays available.
